official.description: Applications are invited from suitably qualified Barbadians for the Errol Walton Barrow Scholarships at undergraduate and postgraduate levels, for students of newer secondary schools, which may be awarded in Marine Studies, Aeronautics, or Culinary Arts. The scholarship covers full tuition fees payable directly to the university, an economy-class airfare out and return, and a destination-specific annual living allowance, subject to a bond obliging the holder to return and work in Barbados for one year for each year of the award.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a Government of Barbados bonded scholarship that pays full overseas tuition plus a fixed annual living allowance and economy airfare, but only for graduates of the Ministry's twelve listed newer secondary schools who study marine studies, aeronautics, or culinary arts. Because the living allowance is a flat figure that varies only by destination (USA / Canada / UK) and is not indexed to real living costs, recipients should expect to self-fund part of their day-to-day expenses, especially in high-cost US and UK cities. The trade-off is a binding bond: you must return to Barbados and work one year for every year funded, secured by sureties, so acceptance is a career commitment rather than simply free study.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Graduates of Barbados's listed newer secondary schools holding an offer in marine studies, aeronautics, or culinary arts who are willing to return and work in Barbados after graduating.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your secondary school appears on the Ministry's newer-secondary-schools list published with the call.
Secure an acceptance offer from an accredited institution in one of the three funded fields before applying; the notice requires acceptance.
Download the current-year Scholarship (Fellowship) Application Form from the Ministry's Download Forms page rather than reusing an old copy.
Identify potential sureties early, since winners must enter a bond guaranteeing return service.
Submit well before the closing date; the Ministry warns that incomplete applications will not be accepted.
common_rejection_risks: Missing the annual closing date, which moved within the 2026 cycle from 3 July to 6 August, so rely on the newest Ministry notice.
An incomplete application; the notice states outright that incomplete applications will not be accepted.
Applying in a field outside Marine Studies, Aeronautics, or Culinary Arts.
Applying from a secondary school not on the Ministry's newer-secondary-schools list.
Not holding an accredited-institution acceptance at the time of application.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Tuition and the two airfares are covered, but the living allowance is a fixed annual sum (published as $6,300.00 USA / $5,880.00 Canada / $7,560.00 United Kingdom, currency not stated on the notice) that is unlikely to meet full living costs in high-cost US or UK cities; accommodation above the allowance, food, health insurance, visa fees, and books generally remain the student's own expense.
document_audit: Only the completed Scholarship (Fellowship) Application Form is named on the public notice; the notice does not itemise supporting attachments, so confirm current attachment requirements with the Tertiary Section before the deadline.
Because incomplete applications are rejected, cross-check every form field (personal details, chosen field, institution, and acceptance status) before submitting.
Clarify with the Tertiary Section whether surety documentation for the bond is required at application stage or only after selection.
alerts: The published closing date changed within the 2026 cycle (an earlier notice listed 3 July 2026 while the 27 July notice set 6 August 2026); rely on the most recent Ministry notice, not dated third-party listings.
Open only to citizens of Barbados; foreign nationals are not eligible.
The award is bonded: you owe one year of service in Barbados for each year funded, backed by sureties.
The currency of the living allowance is not specified on the notice; confirm the currency and disbursement terms with the Tertiary Section.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Download the current form, complete every field, and submit it to the Tertiary Section (in person at the Elsie Payne Complex, by post, or by email to tertiary@mes.gov.bb) before the official closing date; the Ministry screens for completeness before assessment.
